irlights.config.lighting.diffuse-comment: Illuminate surfaces with IRLights. When disabled, specular reflections, contours and volumetric lighting can remain active.
irlights.config.lighting.intensity-comme: Brightness multiplier for diffuse lighting, specular reflections and contours. Volumetric lighting has a separate intensity control.
irlights.config.lighting.specular-commen: Enable glossy reflections from IRLights using the shaderpack reflection model.
irlights.config.lighting.specular_intens: Multiplier for specular brightness. 0 hides reflections but does not reduce cost; disable specular reflections to skip that rendering work.
irlights.config.lighting.title: Lighting
irlights.config.lighting.tooltip: Surface brightness, reflections and cartoon shading.
irlights.config.lighting.toon-comment: Divide diffuse lighting into flat brightness bands. Disabled by default.
irlights.config.lighting.toon_bands-comm: Number of brightness bands when cartoon shading is enabled.
irlights.config.lighting.toon_smooth-com: Smoothness of transitions between cartoon shading bands. 0 produces sharp transitions.
irlights.config.outline.outline-comment: Draw illuminated silhouettes and a Fresnel halo, colored by the light and attenuated with distance. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.outline.outline_back-com: Contour brightness on surfaces facing away from the light. 0 disables it.
irlights.config.outline.outline_fresnel_: Higher values concentrate the glow near the silhouette; lower values spread it across the surface.
irlights.config.outline.outline_front-co: Also draw a contour on surfaces facing the light. Disabled by default.
irlights.config.outline.outline_front_st: Brightness of the front-lit contour. Used only when front-lit contours are enabled. The value is preserved when disabled.
irlights.config.outline.outline_glow-com: Add a soft Fresnel halo inside the silhouette. The shader bloom can enhance it. Disabled by default.
irlights.config.outline.outline_glow_str: Brightness of the inner halo. Used only when inner glow is enabled. The value is preserved when disabled.
irlights.config.outline.outline_pixel_si: Distance between depth samples, in pixels. Larger values produce thicker but less precise contours.
irlights.config.outline.outline_strength: Overall brightness of illuminated contours. 0 makes them invisible.
irlights.config.outline.outline_target-c: Apply contours to all surfaces, only entities or only blocks. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.outline.title: Contours
irlights.config.patcher.title: Shader patching
irlights.config.presets.max_shader_light: Maximum number of lights sent to the shader. 0 means unlimited. Nearest lights have priority when the limit is exceeded. Quality presets do not change this limit.
irlights.config.presets.show_guides-comm: Display wireframe guides for point lights and spotlights in the world.
irlights.config.presets.title: Presets
irlights.config.presets.tooltip: Rendering quality and the appearance of light beams.
irlights.config.presets.vl_intensity-com: Brightness multiplier for volumetric lighting. 1 uses the default brightness; 0 disables it. Requires a shaderpack patched with runtime controls.
irlights.config.shadows.shadow_blocks-co: World blocks cast shadows using their actual shape. Transparent texture pixels do not cast shadows. Increases rendering cost.
irlights.config.shadows.shadow_partial_t: Update only the area occupied by moving subjects. Faster, but shadows may be clipped when a model extends beyond its collision box. Disable for oversized models.
irlights.config.shadows.shadow_quality-c: Resolution of shadow depth maps. Higher resolution produces sharper shadows and uses more video memory.
irlights.config.shadows.shadow_softness-: Apparent light source size. 0 produces sharp shadows; larger values soften distant shadow edges. A light with its own source size overrides this value.
irlights.config.shadows.shadows_live-com: Enable shadows from IRLights. Disabling this and volumetric shadows also stops shadow map updates and releases their memory. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.shadows.title: Shadows
irlights.config.title: IRLights
irlights.config.volumetric.title: Volumetric lighting
irlights.config.volumetric.tooltip: Light beams, fog and animated noise.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_dither_tem: Change the noise pattern every frame. Disable if moving lights cause visible flickering in recordings without temporal anti-aliasing.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_max_dist-c: Maximum distance of volumetric light rays, in blocks. Longer rays cost more to render. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_noise_amou: Strength of density variations inside the light beam. Small values produce uniform light; 1 produces distinct clouds while preserving average brightness.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_noise_live: Enable animated noise inside light beams. Disabling it produces uniform beams. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_noise_morp: Speed at which density clouds change shape. 0 disables shape changes. Uses an additional noise sample. Values snap to 0.25 increments to keep animation continuous.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_noise_scal: Approximate size of the density clouds, in blocks. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_noise_spee: Speed at which density clouds move. 0 stops movement. Values snap to 0.25 increments to keep animation continuous at cycle boundaries.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_noise_stri: Sample density noise every N ray samples and reuse the result between samples. 1 samples every step. Larger intervals reduce cost but may introduce visible bands.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_shadow_str: Sample shadows every N ray samples and reuse the previous result between samples. 1 samples every step; larger intervals reduce rendering cost.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_shadows_li: Enable shadows inside volumetric light beams. When disabled, beams pass through objects. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_steps-comm: Number of samples along each light ray. Higher values improve smoothness but increase rendering cost. Requires a shaderpack patched with runtime controls.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_tip_boost-: Additional volumetric brightness near the light source. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
irlights.config.volumetric.vl_tip_radius: Radius of the additional glow around the light source, in blocks. Requires runtime controls in the patched shaderpack.
